title: Before Sunrise
creator: Richard Linklater
summary: Two strangers spend a night walking and talking in Vienna. That's the whole film. It's enough.
personalNote: A film built entirely on conversation and the feeling that a night like this could happen to you. Linklater trusts his actors and his audience completely. There's no plot. There doesn't need to be. Some films make you want things. This one made me want to walk around a city with someone I didn't know yet.
